class.name: IfcStructuralPointAction
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Defines an action which acts on a point. A point action is typically connected with a point connection. It may also be connected with a curve member or curve connection, or surface member or surface connection. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2.
